newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal Corp Q3 March 31 rises.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal Corp Q3 March 31 rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The company reported operating earnings of $16.2 million, or $0.74, compared to $15.4 million, or $0.68, a year ago. The 1996 operating earnings have been adjusted to reflect a three-for-two stock split distributed January 14 to shareholders of record December 31. Additionally, the Q3 1996 figure includes an income tax benefit of $1.0 million, or $0.05 a share, from the final disposition of leases the company owned in a nuclear generating facility.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: The nine-month figure for 1997 includes the company's share of a one-time special assessment to recapitalize the Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF), which amounted to an after-tax charge of $17.3 million, or $0.79 a share. It also includes an extraordinary loss on early retirement of debt of $583,000, or $0.03 a share and an after-tax charge of $1.5 million, or $0.07 a share, for transaction costs related to the company's repurchase of 1.9 million common shares.
